
Summary {data-navmenu="Gene sets"}
=====================================

```{r}
gs_de_cnt <- bind_rows(lapply(names(gsea_de), function(ct) {
    data.frame(contrast = ct, up = sum(gsea_de[[ct]]$direction == "Up"), down = sum(gsea_de[[ct]]$direction == "Down"),
               tested = nrow(gsea_de[[ct]]))
}))
gs_ds_cnt <- bind_rows(lapply(names(gsea_ds), function(ct) {
    g <- gsea_ds[[ct]]
    data.frame(contrast = ct,
               hi = sum(g$significant & g$gene_list == "Higher inclusion"),
               lo = sum(g$significant & g$gene_list == "Lower inclusion"))
}))
if (nrow(gs_de_cnt)) gs_de_cnt <- gs_de_cnt[order(match(gs_de_cnt$contrast, ct_levels)), ]
if (nrow(gs_ds_cnt)) gs_ds_cnt <- gs_ds_cnt[order(match(gs_ds_cnt$contrast, ct_levels)), ]
```

Row {data-height=500}
-------------------------------------

### Gene sets regulated by expression (preranked GSEA, FDR < `r fdr_gs`)

```{r}
if (!nrow(gs_de_cnt)) {
    message_box("No expression GSEA results were found (run the pipeline with --limma --gsea).")
} else {
    updown_barplot(gs_de_cnt$contrast, gs_de_cnt$up, gs_de_cnt$down,
                   ylab = "Number of gene sets regulated", noun = "gene sets") |>
        layout(title = list(text = paste0("GSEA ranked by limma ", run_param("gsea_rank_by", "t"),
                                          "; FDR < ", fdr_gs), x = 0.02, font = list(size = 14)))
}
```

### Gene sets over-represented among spliced genes (FDR < `r fdr_gs`)

```{r}
if (!nrow(gs_ds_cnt)) {
    message_box("No splicing gene set results were found (run the pipeline with --rmats --gsea).")
} else {
    updown_barplot(gs_ds_cnt$contrast, gs_ds_cnt$hi, gs_ds_cnt$lo,
                   up_name = "Higher-inclusion genes", down_name = "Lower-inclusion genes",
                   ylab = "Number of gene sets enriched", legend_title = "Gene list", noun = "gene sets") |>
        layout(title = list(text = paste0("Over-representation (fora); FDR < ", fdr_gs), x = 0.02, font = list(size = 14)))
}
```

Row {data-height=600}
-------------------------------------

### Gene sets regulated by expression, all contrasts (FDR < `r fdr_gs`)

```{r}
tab <- bind_rows(lapply(gsea_de, function(g) g[g$direction != "NS", ]))
if (!nrow(tab)) {
    message_box("No gene sets pass the cut-off.")
} else {
    tab <- tab |> arrange(match(contrast, ct_levels), padj, desc(abs(NES)))
    capped_table(tab |> transmute(contrast, pathway, collection, direction, NES, padj, size, leading_edge_n,
                                  leading_edge = first_genes(leading_edge)),
                 "gsea_expression_significant.tsv", numeric_cols = "NES", sci_cols = "padj",
                 full_df = tab)
}
```

Row {data-height=600}
-------------------------------------

### Gene sets over-represented among spliced genes, all contrasts (FDR < `r fdr_gs`)

```{r}
tab <- bind_rows(lapply(gsea_ds, function(g) g[g$significant, ]))
if (!nrow(tab)) {
    message_box("No gene sets pass the cut-off.")
} else {
    tab <- tab |> arrange(match(contrast, ct_levels), padj)
    capped_table(tab |> transmute(contrast, gene_list, pathway, collection, overlap, size, fold_enrichment, padj,
                                  overlap_genes = first_genes(overlap_genes)),
                 "gsea_splicing_significant.tsv", numeric_cols = "fold_enrichment", sci_cols = "padj",
                 full_df = tab)
}
```
